meta.source: Himawari-9 AHI L1b band 13 (10.4 um), anonymous AWS bucket noaa-himawari9
meta.interpretation: Equals cloud-top temperature only for opaque cloud; clear sky shows the surface; thin cirrus reads warmer than its top.
meta.observed_at_note: scan of the India segments takes place within the 10 minutes after the nominal time
meta.cell_statistic: p10 and minimum of valid pixel BT whose centre lies in the cell (nearest 0.25 deg centre)
meta.rate_definition: p10 BT(now) - p10 BT(earlier), per hour; negative = cooling
meta.quality: view_zenith_deg > 70 means large pixels and parallax: treat values as coarse
meta.missing_data: null = no valid pixel (or no earlier frame for the rate); never replaced by a default
